title: NIST WebBook: Gold is Au, molecular weight 196.966569 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Gold as Au, molecular weight 196.966569 amu, CAS 7440-57-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Gold, CAS Registry Number 7440-57-5, lists molecular formula Au and molecular weight 196.966569 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 196.9665687 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Au. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
